outcome: complete removal of retained products of conception (RPOC) without complications
referral to surgical procedure under anesthesia
cohort: A total of 175 patients with confirmed retained products of conception (RPOC) underwent see-and-treat operative office hysteroscopy without anesthesia in an outpatient clinic.
finding: Office operative hysteroscopy without anesthesia achieved complete removal of retained products of conception (RPOC) in 95.1% of cases, demonstrating its feasibility and high effectiveness.
